name: Bakunyuu Layer Ore no Haramase Niku Onaho! ~Tomodachi no Kanojo o Netori Koubi de Chin Kobi Layer ni!~
original_name: 爆乳レイヤーは俺の孕ませ肉オナホ！ ～友達の彼女を寝取り交尾でチン媚びレイヤーに！～
source:
Things in the 2D waifu appreciation society are going great! You have a place to read doujins and chat with people namely your buddies Yuuto, an amateur artist, and Airi, the cosplay connoisseur. The only downside is the insufferable "will-they-wont-they" dynamic between Yuuto and Airi, Yuuto being a human completely devoid of rizz doesn't pick up any of the hints Airi puts down. This romantic tension really makes it awkward to read *cultured* literature.

Your moment arrives one day as you're heading to the club room to retrieve some especially potent dirty mags you left behind and what do you happen to see? Airi in full Ponpoko cosplay, face flushed redder than her outfit, quietly skimming through the exact hentai you were trying to grab!. Let Yuuto wear his mom's spaghetti, you're not about to miss your one shot, one opportunity, to seize the heart of Airi! You maybe nervous, but on the surface your hard and ready to bust. Saddle up next to her and revel in the depravity, page by page, lewd act after lewd act the once cutesy cosplayer is on a one-way trip to become a dripping and drooling, cock-hungry cumdumpster.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956310/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2D waifu鉴赏会进展顺利！你有一个地方可以阅读同人并与人们聊天，即你的好友Yuuto（业余艺术家）和Airi（角色扮演鉴赏家）。唯一的缺点是Yuuto和Airi之间令人难以忍受的“他们会不会他们不会”的动态，Yuuto是一个完全没有活力的人类，他不会接受Airi给出的任何暗示。这种浪漫的张力确实让阅读“有文化的”文学变得尴尬。

有一天，你的时刻到来了，当你前往俱乐部房间取回你留下的一些特别有效的肮脏杂志时，你碰巧看到了什么？身着全套Ponpoko角色扮演的爱理，脸涨得比她的衣服还红，静静地浏览着你想要抓住的无尽漫画！让勇斗穿上他妈妈的意大利面，你不会错过一次抓住爱理心的机会！你也许很紧张，但表面上你很坚强，准备崩溃。坐在她旁边，陶醉在堕落之中，一页一页，一次又一次的猥亵行为，曾经可爱的角色扮演者正踏上单程之旅，变成一个滴水流口水、饥肠辘辘的垃圾箱。
